capture-id.description: Capture UUID assigned by this instance.

download.description: Link to the capture archive, downloaded files or video. Availability is not guaranteed.

error.description: Capture error or endpoint failure; the comment identifies the endpoint.

hostname.description: Hostname observed among capture resources; no IP mapping is implied.

instance.description: Base URL of the Lookyloo instance.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address observed among capture resources.

raw-data.description: JSON response from an endpoint, named for that endpoint. Includes original node identifiers, third-party results and pagination metadata when available.

redirect.description: URL in the redirect chain; the comment records its position.

status.description: Numeric capture status code returned by Lookyloo; this is not a verdict.

text.description: Analyst notes, lookup warnings or output truncation notices.

user-agent.description: User agent used by the capturing browser.

description: A Lookyloo web capture and its provenance, as returned by the public API (https://lookyloo.circl.lu/doc/). Identified by instance and capture-id. Captured resources, files, cookies and screenshots can be linked as separate objects. Presence in a capture is an observation, not a maliciousness verdict. Redirect order is recorded in attribute comments; raw-data attachments preserve endpoint responses and lookup pagination metadata.
name: lookyloo-capture
